paper_contract: Source-generated process algebra, third edition, C1–C54

claims.title: 完整源程序在实际输入上重生并作用于保留余项

titles.zh: 完整源程序在实际输入上重生并作用于保留余项
titles.en: The complete source programme regenerates on the actual input and acts on the retained remainder

claims.statement_scope: 逐阶的原代码在各次实际输入上执行。联合求值恢复完整输入上的值，原写入交付下一原包。

statements.zh: 逐阶的原代码在各次实际输入上执行。联合求值恢复完整输入上的值，原写入交付下一原包。
statements.en: The source code executes on each actual input. Joint evaluation recovers the value on the complete input, and the original write produces the next packet.

claims.title: 共同源输入与线性接收器出处

titles.zh: 共同源输入与线性接收器出处
titles.en: Common source input and linear receiver provenance

claims.statement_scope: 原查询与执行轨迹读取同一完整源式。下一环境由实际出生生成。线性接收器在每个已登记发生处读取源并保全写入、整账和后继。

statements.zh: 原查询与执行轨迹读取同一完整源式。下一环境由实际出生生成。线性接收器在每个已登记发生处读取源并保全写入、整账和后继。
statements.en: The query and its execution trace read the same complete source expression. The actual birth supplies the next environment. The linear receiver reads the source at each registered occurrence and preserves the write, the whole ledger, and the successor.
